app.name: MARKEN
app.tagline: Your AI marketing team. One ready post every day.
nav.label: Main
common.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
landing.title: Your real product, never redrawn.
landing.body: Marken prepares one ready Instagram post for your shop every morning, with your real product in every slide. You approve with one tap.
landing.step1Body: Upload 3–10 photos. Marken cuts out your real product and never redraws it.
landing.step2Body: Every morning, a 3-slide carousel built around a trend that fits your shop.
landing.step3Body: Nothing publishes without you. Approve, edit, or skip.
login.title: Welcome back
login.body: Sign in to see today's post for your shop.
login.sentBody: We sent you a sign-in link. Open it on this phone to continue.
ob1.title: Tell us about your shop
ob1.body: This helps Marken write posts that sound like your shop.
ob1.name: Shop name
ob2.title: Add your product photos
ob2.body: Add 3–10 clear photos. Marken cuts out each product and never redraws it.
ob2.need: Add at least 3 photos to continue.
ob3.title: Check your products
ob3.body: Confirm each cutout looks right. You can fix names and prices here.
ob3.name: Product name
ob4.title: Make it sound like you
ob4.body: Pick a tone and add rules. Marken follows them in every post.
ob4.sampleText: A little glow for your morning. ✨ Your LUMI Daily Serum, ready when you are.
ob4.ig: Connect Instagram to publish for you
ob5.title: Your first post is on its way
ob5.body: While it is made, here is a sample of what you will see every morning.
tour.1: This is your daily post. Swipe through all 3 slides.
tour.2: This badge means your real product was checked, never redrawn.
tour.3: See what the agent did, step by step, and what it cost.
products.title: Products
products.body: {n} products in your shop. Marken only posts products you have checked.
products.name: Product name
products.checkBody: Marken cut out your product from the photo. This exact cutout is what appears in your posts.
products.deleteBody: {name} will be removed from your shop and future posts. Past posts are not changed.
products.nameError: Give the product a name first.
products.empty: No products yet. Add your first product photo.
settings.title: Settings
settings.name: Shop name
settings.igBody: Marken publishes your approved carousels to this account. Nothing posts without your approval.
settings.remindBody: One email when today's post is ready for your review.
settings.deleteBody: This permanently deletes {name}, its products, photos and posts. This cannot be undone.
settings.deletedBody: Your shop, products and media are gone. Thanks for trying Marken.
edit.title: Make this caption yours.
edit.body: Edit the words yourself, or tell Marken what to change.
edit.caption: Caption
edit.limit: You have used all 5 rewrites for this post today.
today.title: Your morning, sorted.
today.subtitle: Your daily carousel is ready for a little you.
today.caption: Your caption
skip.title: Not the right moment?
skip.body: Your feedback helps avoid this trend in your next posts.
status.none.title: No post yet today.
status.none.body: Your daily post is prepared every morning. Want one now?
status.generating.title: A fresh post is taking shape.
status.generating.body: Your progress is saved. You can leave this screen.
status.publishing.title: Your post is on its way.
status.publishing.body: Approved by you. Publishing to Instagram in the background.
status.published.title: Hello, Instagram.
status.published.body: Your carousel is live. Your real product, in every slide.
status.download.title: Post it your way.
status.download.body: Instagram isn’t connected. Download your slides, copy the caption, and post them in order.
status.download.note: Not published by Marken. Downloading doesn’t publish.
status.failed.title: Let’s get this moving again.
status.failed.body: Your post has not been published. Three attempts were unsuccessful.
status.genFailed.body: Today’s post couldn’t be finished. Nothing was published.
status.fidelity.title: This slide needs a second look.
status.fidelity.body: The product check did not pass on slide {n}, so this post can’t be approved.
status.skipped.title: Today’s post is skipped.
status.skipped.body: Nothing was published. Your next suggestion will use a different trend.
